title: Make CI on main green and enforced, validate before push, and generate Rust from JavaScript instead of writing it twice
Self-translation: an import names items its module does not translate (use crate::m::{a, b} with b unbound)
Self-translation: a module's own helper paths are crate-rooted (crate::ml_*) while its imports name sibling modules (use crate::m::…), so no crate holds both
selfTranslate writes a long Rust expression on one line; wrap it (vec! literals reach 1,250 characters)
selfTranslate parses each module twice at about 5 KB/s; parse once and speed up the lossless JavaScript parse
Self-translation items should keep the portable-core diagnostic, not only its kind
Self-translation types an unannotated parameter from one item's body, so the Rust signature can contradict every caller
Portable core: const destructuring in for…of, string switch cases, try/catch, typeof, let without initialiser (62 carried items in formal-ai)
JavaScript lexer misreads regex literals as malformed numbers or unterminated strings; regex subset support (84 carried items in formal-ai)
Portable core: new Set/new Map, Error subclasses and classes (110 carried items in formal-ai)
Portable core: string methods .split/.slice/.indexOf/.replace/.replaceAll/.codePointAt and code-point iteration (183 carried items in formal-ai)
Portable core: array methods .map/.filter/.find/.some/.every/.push/.join/.reduce and Array.from (324 carried items in formal-ai)
Portable core: arrow functions and closures as values inside function bodies (99 carried items in formal-ai)
Portable core: plain object records without a $ tag, their field reads, and frozen constant namespaces (129 carried items in formal-ai)
Portable core: JSDoc tuple, record, Map/Set types and optional [param] syntax (210 carried items in formal-ai)
Portable core: null, undefined, ?? and ?. as Option<T> (218 carried items in formal-ai)
Finish the remaining issue #195 scope after PR #196: self-translation, native grammars for every language, multi-source merging, interchange, semantics and release
Provide a no_std ECMAScript tokenizer and a lossless JS/TS <-> link-network pivot for WASM consumers
Update all dependencies to their latest releases (links-notation 0.13->0.22, tree-sitter 0.25->0.27, lindera 3->6, 6 more) and enforce freshness in CI
